name: Temporary residence permit for family reunification (zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy w celu połączenia z rodziną)

requirement_groups.name: Spouse or family member of a Polish citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a genuine, legally-recognised marriage to a Polish citizen resident in Poland, or another documented family tie protected under Article 8 ECHR.

outcome_override.physical_presence_requirement: 3 years of marriage plus at least 2 years of continuous residence in Poland on a marriage-linked temporary permit, directly before the permanent-residence application

requirement_groups.name: Spouse, minor child, or dependent of a non-Polish resident with an established status

requirements.blocker_text: The Poland-resident family member (sponsor) must hold a Single Permit for at least 2 years, or hold an EU Blue Card, ICT permit, permanent residence, or EU long-term resident status.
requirements.fix_path: Wait for the sponsor to accrue the required residence history, or for the sponsor to obtain a qualifying permit type.

requirements.blocker_text: The sponsor must show a stable, regular income above PLN 1,010/month net (single-person threshold) or PLN 823/month net per household member, sufficient to support the family member joining -- unless the sponsor is a Polish citizen's spouse, in which case this is waived.
requirements.fix_path: Document income above the relevant social-assistance threshold, or arrange for a family member obliged to provide support to cover costs instead.

requirements.blocker_text: Confirmed accommodation in Poland is required (lease, ownership, or a hosting declaration).

evidence_required.document: Marriage or birth certificate proving the family tie (issued within 3 months of the application)
Sponsor's valid residence permit or Polish ID
Proof of accommodation and, where required, income

outcome.duration_length: matches the sponsor's permit validity, up to 3 years
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 5 years continuous legal residence for the general family-of-foreign-resident path (see the spouse-of-Polish-citizen group above for the faster 3-year alternative)

sources.title: Powroty.gov.pl (official Polish government portal, gov.pl domain) -- Zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy
Moduł Obsługi Spraw (mos.cudzoziemcy.gov.pl, Office for Foreigners' official case-handling portal) -- Rodzina
Lubuski Urząd Wojewódzki (regional government office, BIP public-information portal) -- income criteria for family reunification

notes: Uses outcome_override precisely as documented in the schema's design brief: spouses of Polish citizens get a materially faster and easier path (income/insurance/accommodation waived entirely, 3-year combined marriage-plus-residence route to permanent residence) than family members joining a foreign national resident on a Single Permit, Blue Card, or similar status (full 5-year standard track, income and housing tests apply). This is a genuine two-different-outcomes case, not a cosmetic variation -- the correct use of the schema mechanism per the Turkey Temporary Protection and UK Global Talent precedents in the project brief. Income threshold figures (PLN 1,010/month net single-person, PLN 823/month net per household member) come from the 2024 Rada Ministrów social-assistance-criteria regulation and are confirmed unchanged through 2026 in multiple contemporaneous 2026 sources (rynekzdrowia.pl, infor.pl) -- these criteria update on a 3-year cycle, so the next re-basing is expected around 2027, flagged for future freshness monitoring on this route specifically. fam_sponsor_status's 2-year Single-Permit-holder threshold and the qualifying alternate statuses (Blue Card, ICT, permanent residence, EU long-term residence) are drawn from mos.cudzoziemcy.gov.pl's official FAQ rather than the primary statutory text (ustawa o cudzoziemcach) directly -- treated as tier-1 since mos.cudzoziemcy.gov.pl is the Office for Foreigners' own official case-handling system, but flagged for anyone wanting the exact article number.
